newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee ends flat, no big move seen.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee ends flat, no big move seen.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed barely moved against the dollar on Tuesday, after trading in a tight threer-cent range, dealers said.
"The rupee moved between 56.88 and 56.91, sandwiched between slight import covering at one end and selling at the other," said an American Express Bank dealer.

The local currency closed at 56.90, matching a closing low set last Thursday, after opening at 56.86. No trading was reported for the first two hours or so as dealers were uncomefortable with the near-record low level versus the dollar.

Dealers said the dollar-rupee exchange rate would stay around the current level this week in the absence of a big import bill or remittances from abroad. There was a firm resistance as the rupee neared 57 to the U.S. unit, they said.
Overnight call money ended at its previous closing rate of 15.5 percent, with the market well offered.
Dealers said stabilising money rates would not lead to dollar build-ups as dealers were reluctant to commit themselves around the 57 rupee level.
